title: different behavior in development vs production build
body:
### Vue version

3.2.39

### Link to minimal reproduction

https://github.com/stefanprobst/vue-d3-issue

### Steps to reproduce

- navigate to `/first-page` and see a `<circle>` element rendered
- click on the link to "Second page" in the page header, and then click on the link to "First page" in the page header



### What is expected?

only one `<circle>` element is rendered

### What is actually happening?

- in a development build, only one `<circle>` element is rendered, which is the behavior i expected. it is also the behavior in `vue@2` with options api (see the [`options-api`](https://github.com/stefanprobst/vue-d3-issue/tree/options-api) branch in the minimal reproduction).
- in a production build however, all previously rendered `<circle>` elements remain visible.
